description: This Java test class 'DatabaseDetectiveIT' contains integration tests for the 'DatabaseDetective' class, focusing on database state recognition such as detecting if the database is empty or contains specific tables related to Liquibase changelogs and OpenMRS tables.

classes.name: DatabaseDetectiveIT
classes.description: Integration test class for 'DatabaseDetective', verifying database state detection logic such as emptiness or presence of specific tables.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test dependencies and database connection properties before each test.

methods.name: shouldRecogniseDatabaseWithoutAnyTables
methods.description: Test to verify that the database is recognized as empty when no tables are present.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreLiquibaseChangeLogTables
methods.description: Test to verify that Liquibase changelog tables are ignored when assessing database emptiness.

methods.name: shouldRecogniseDatabaseContainsOpenmrsTables
methods.description: Test to verify detection of existing OpenMRS tables in the database.
